newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin spokesman - govt not against De Beers deal.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin spokesman - govt not against De Beers deal.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin's press secretary, Sergei Yastrzhembsky, told a regular news briefing on Friday that the Russian government was not against a diamond export deal with South African gem group De Beers.
"One cannot interprete the situation as being that the government opposes the deal. That would be the most untrue interpretation," he said.

"Naturally, all the basic points of the deal will be preserved," Yastrzhembsky said. "But the government, in its approach to and analysis of the situation, is taking into account the interests of the Russian Federation."
He said experts were still discussing all aspects of the deal from legal and economic points of view.
"The prepared draft agreement will then be submitted to the government and president. After they discuss it, there will be a decision," he said.
Yastrzhembsky referred to recent remarks by Finance Minister Alexander Livshits on the status of the deal as "strange".

"What the finance minister said was strange," he said, referring to comments by Livshits earlier this week that Russia wanted to amend the draft agreement to provide more rough stones for the domestic industry.
